## Question and result

What one question does this change answer? What changed?

## Evidence

Source revision or hash, command or method, observed result, and safe artifact link. Separate verified facts from inference and unresolved points.

## Safety and publication check

- [ ] I reviewed the full diff for vendor binaries, backups, footage, credentials, private device or network identifiers, and generated executables.
- [ ] I stated whether a physical camera or LAN device was contacted.
- [ ] I linked or corrected any older claim this supersedes.
- [ ] I updated the port status only if an evidence gate changed.
